initial_requirements: Researchers need a standalone application for playing and extending combinatorial games based on triangulations. Players with varying technical experience should be able to choose among several game types and play alone, against computer-controlled opponents, or with another person through an accessible graphical interface. Game developers should also be able to define new games and make them available without modifying the original application.

messages.content: What specific actions and capabilities should the application provide for players and game developers—for example, game selection, solo play, computer opponents, two-player play, and creating or adding new games without changing the core application?

Players should be able to open the app, browse the available triangulation-based games, and pick one to play without needing technical setup. From there, they should have options to play alone, play against a computer opponent, or play head-to-head with another person on the same accessible interface.
For game developers, the application should let them define a new game as a separate add-on or module and then make it appear in the list of available games. Ideally they should not need to modify or recompile the core application just to add new games, but I’d want to confirm the exact plugin or extension mechanism with the team.
